OUR FOUNDER
Mzee H J Paunrana
(1935 – 2009)

Patience and perseverance are
necessary qualities to achieve material
success, but true business success is
only achieved when you begin to serve
the needs and the interests of the
country and its people and do so by
fair and honest means.
Mzee Paunrana, paraphrasing
JRD Tata, whom he admired
greatly.
